descriptions.zh:
我们与一艘在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]的科研船[this.GetName]失去了联系。

最后的通讯表明他们当时正在调查一颗附近的小行星，[cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]。

建议靠近这个恒星系的话一定要小心点。
descriptions.en:
We have lost communication with our science ship [this.GetName] in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].

Their last transmission indicated they were beginning a survey on a nearby asteroid, [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName].

Caution is advised when re-entering this system.

descriptions.zh: 在星系中世世代代的海盗们把他们的不义之财藏在精心安放的宝库中。许多秘密宝藏都被遗弃或被认为已经丢失，但现在它们是我们的囊中之物了。
descriptions.en: Throughout this galaxy's history, pirates have hidden their ill-gotten gains in carefully placed Treasure Troves. Many of those secret caches were abandoned and considered lost, but now they are ours for the taking.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一张神秘的星图，于是决定踏上最伟大的冒险之旅。谁知道§H星国图志§!的尽头隐藏着什么，以及我们在旅途中会遇到什么危险。
descriptions.en: After discovering a mysterious map to the stars, we embarked on our greatest adventure. Who knows what lies at the end of the §HCelestial Chart§!, and what dangers we may face on our journey.

descriptions.zh:
星系中的虚空虫数量已达到无法继续维持的水平，必须将其彻底消灭。

我们已经找到了所有剩余的§Y虚空虫巢穴§!，必须将其摧毁。
descriptions.en:
The Voidworm population in the galaxy has reached unsustainable levels, and they must be eradicated.

We have located all remaining §YVoidworm Nests§! that must be destroyed.
